Testimonials.subtitle: What do our users say about us?

reviews.name: Jasurbek T.
reviews.text: Extremely fast servers for my Django projects. The NVMe drives really make a noticeable difference. Support works 24/7 and answers every question quickly.

reviews.name: Malika K.
reviews.text: Our corporate website is hosted here. Its resilience against DDoS attacks and the 99.99% uptime guarantee are crucial for our business. The prices are affordable too.

reviews.name: Sardor M.
reviews.text: The ISPmanager panel is very convenient. Connecting a new domain and SSL takes just a few minutes. The technical support is truly professional.

items.q: How long does it take for hosting to activate after purchase?
items.a: Once the payment is completed, your hosting is activated automatically within a few minutes, and all login details are sent to you by email.

items.q: Can I migrate my website from another provider?
items.a: Absolutely! Our technical team will migrate your website from your current provider to us for free and without any data loss.
You can pay with Payme, Click, Paynet, Xazna, Humo, Ucard, Oson, Plum, Visa, Mastercard and cryptocurrencies.

items.q: Is there protection against DDoS attacks?
items.a: Yes, all our plans include powerful L3-L7 level DDoS protection. Attacks never reach your website.
Our 24/7 support team is always available via Telegram, live chat and phone. We resolve any issue quickly.
